mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM task_file WHERE task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY status

SELECT f.id AS file_id, f.file_path AS file_path, f.priority_reason AS priority_reason, COUNT(i.id) AS issue_count FROM task_file f LEFT JOIN review_issue i ON i.file_id = f.id AND i.task_id = f.task_id WHERE f.task_id = #{taskId} AND f.priority_reason IS NOT NULL AND f.priority_reason <> '' GROUP BY f.id, f.file_path, f.priority_reason ORDER BY issue_count DESC, f.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
